info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trust Services Retrieval API
info.description: The Trust Services Retrieval API is designed to provide seamless access to information pertaining to various trust services offered to consumers. Through a simple GET request, users can retrieve detailed insights and data regarding specific trust services by providing the relevant identifier. This API is valuable for financial institutions and service providers looking to integrate trust service information into their applications or customer-facing portals. It empowers stakeholders to enhance their service offerings and improve customer engagement by efficiently accessing vital trust service details.

get.summary: Retrieve Trust Service details by ID
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific Trust Service using its unique identifier. It provides all relevant data associated with the service.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving details about the trust services specifically defined by the operation RES-100045. This body contains necessary input parameters for the request to be processed correctly.
